redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material fact (revenue, segment performance, regional dynamics, profitability, cash flow, financing activities, product launches, and guidance) with no substantive overlap in core content.

key_information_units.information: Total revenue increased organically by 8.6% to DKK 1,558m (reported growth of 3.2%), with Endoscopy Solutions accounting for 63% of revenue and Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring for 37%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue increased organically by 8.6% (19.5%) to DKK 1,558m (DKK 1,510m), with reported growth of 3.2% (20.4%). Endoscopy Solutions contributed 986m DKK (63% of total revenue) and Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring contributed 572m DKK (37% of total revenue) as detailed in the Business Performance table.

key_information_units.information: Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%, primarily driven by Urology, ENT, & GI (21.0% organic growth) and Respiratory (8.3% organic growth).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Endoscopy Solutions delivered strong organic growth of 14.4% (20.6%), with Urology, ENT, & GI posting 21.0% organic growth (mainly driven by aScope 4 portfolio) and Respiratory posting 8.3% organic growth, as stated in the Endoscopy Solutions performance section.

key_information_units.information: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring reported flat organic growth of -0.1%, attributed to extraordinarily high comparable revenue from the prior-year quarter.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year, per the Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring section.

key_information_units.information: Regional organic growth varied: North America +9.8%, Europe +9.7%, and Rest of World -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high prior-year comparables.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America (9.8%) and Europe (9.7%), while Rest of World declined by -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from last year, as shown in the Geographies table.

key_information_units.information: EBIT margin before special items was 10.5% (adjusted to 15.2% excluding tariff costs and FX headwinds), reflecting operational leverage offset by external factors.
key_information_units.source_evidence: EBIT margin b.s.i. was 10.5%. Adjusting for tariff costs and FX headwinds, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2%, with the decline attributed to external factors while underlying performance showed operational leverage, per EBIT margin analysis.

key_information_units.information: Free cash flow before acquisitions was DKK 13m, primarily impacted by elevated net working capital, FX headwinds, and tariff costs.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m (DKK 69m). This was mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital, which remained elevated to mitigate global geopolitical uncertainties, and was further impacted by FX headwinds and tariff costs, as detailed in Cash Flow comments.

key_information_units.information: Ambu paid a dividend of DKK 90m (DKK 0.41 per share) in Q1.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1, corresponding to DKK 0.41 per share, per the Financial Highlights and Cash Flow from Financing Activities section.

key_information_units.information: Ambu acquired DKK 38m of treasury shares in Q1 as part of its share buyback program.
key_information_units.source_evidence: DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program, as reported in Cash Flow from Financing Activities and the Share-based payment note.

key_information_units.information: Launched the portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope, expanding Ambu’s Respiratory portfolio.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Introduction of Ambu’s portable video laryngoscope solution, SureSight Mobile, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio and Respiratory offering, as highlighted in Business Highlights and Respiratory section.

key_information_units.information: Extended the Ambu Recircle Program to include collection and recycling of video laryngoscope blades in 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Extension of the Ambu Recircle Program to include the collection and recycling of blades from Ambu’s video laryngoscopy solution, Ambu SureSight Connect, planned for 2026, per Business Highlights and Sustainability Update.

key_information_units.information: Maintained FY 2025/26 financial guidance: organic revenue growth of 10-13% and EBIT margin before special items of 12-14% (14-16% excluding tariff impacts).
key_information_units.source_evidence: The 2025/26 financial guidance is maintained: Organic revenue growth 10-13%; EBIT margin b.s.i. 12-14% [14-16% excluding assumed impacts of ~2%-pts from tariffs], as stated in Financial Outlook section.
